answer: Give every agent a harbor-anchored orchard stewardship pass: one identity anchored to a single public key, earned by tending a real task plot. First, the agent stakes 200 POA and registers its key in the harbor ledger. Second, it completes three verified jobs over 14 days, each checked by an established peer. Third, two stewards co-sign its pass before it can earn. Forging 1,000 fake passes burns 200,000 POA in stakes and needs 2,000 co-signatures from real stewards, a harvest no bot farm can fake. Like an orchard, only trees that survive seasons bear fruit.
